question: Tribromomethane is a synonym for which brominated organic solvent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bromoform**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tribromomethane:-**

 
 
• **It is a synonym for bromoform. Bromoform is a colorless liquid with a sweet, chloroform-like odor.**
 
• It is used as a solvent in the production of pharmaceuticals, pesticides, and plastics.
 
• Bromoform is also a byproduct of the chlorination of water.
 
• Here are some other brominated organic solvents:
 
 
• Dibromomethane
 
• Bromodichloromethane
 
• Dibromoethane
 
• Tetrabromoethane
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diborane:-**

 
 
• It is also known as diboron monoxide or boron hydride, is a chemical compound with the formula B2H6.
 
• It is a colorless, highly toxic gas with a pungent odor. Diborane is used as a reducing agent in organic synthesis and as a dopant in the semiconductor industry.
 
 
 
• **Borazine:-**
 
 
• It is also known as boron nitride trimethyl or BNH6, is a chemical compound with the formula B3H6N3.
 
• It is a colorless liquid with a pungent odor. Borazine is used as a precursor to other boron compounds and as a fuel additive.
 
 
 
• **Bromosuccinimide:-**
 
 
• It is also known as NBS or 2,5-dibromo-1,3-pyrroledinone, is a chemical compound with the formula C₄H₄Br₂NO.
 
• It is a white, crystalline solid with a slight odor. Bromosuccinimide is used as a brominating agent in organic synthesis.
